title_en: The Sword of Goujian, King of Yue

background.zh: 这把青铜剑在地下埋藏了两千多年，出土时剑身依旧寒光凛冽，几乎没有锈蚀。
background.en: This bronze sword lay buried underground for more than two thousand years, yet when it was unearthed its blade was still cold and gleaming, with almost no rust.

transcript.zh: 一把剑埋藏两千多年，出土时依然锋利如初，这本身就是一个谜。
transcript.en: That a sword remains as sharp as new after being buried for more than two thousand years is, in itself, a mystery.

transcript.zh: 剑身上刻着八个鸟篆铭文，正是这些文字，让人们确认了它的主人。
transcript.en: Eight bird-seal-script characters are carved into the blade, and it is precisely these characters that allowed people to identify its owner.

transcript.zh: 越王勾践，一个曾经卧薪尝胆的君主，把毅力铸进了这把剑里。
transcript.en: Goujian, King of Yue, a ruler once known for enduring hardship to strengthen his resolve, seemed to have cast that very willpower into this blade.

transcript.zh: 剑越锋利，越需要精湛的工艺来支撑。
transcript.en: The sharper a sword is, the more it depends on masterful craftsmanship to support that sharpness.

transcript.zh: 两千多年后，它依旧安静地躺在展柜中，仿佛从未被时间打败过。
transcript.en: More than two thousand years later, it still lies quietly in its display case, as if it had never once been defeated by time.

sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 用 'That + 从句' 作主语，是一种正式、书面的表达方式，常用于强调一个事实本身令人惊讶或重要。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: Using a 'That-clause' as the subject of a sentence is a formal, written style often used to emphasize that a fact itself is surprising or significant.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: That a sword remains as sharp as new after being buried for more than two thousand years is, in itself, a mystery.
extra_examples: That she finished the marathon after only two months of training surprised everyone.
That the ancient bridge still stands after a thousand years is remarkable.

sentence_patterns.pattern: it is precisely X that... (cleft sentence for emphasis)
sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 强调句型 'it is precisely X that...' 用来突出说明真正起作用的原因或对象。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: This cleft-sentence pattern highlights exactly which element is responsible for something — stronger than simply stating the fact.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: it is precisely these characters that allowed people to identify its owner.
extra_examples: It is precisely this attention to detail that makes her work outstanding.
It is precisely the lack of rust that puzzled scientists for decades.

sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 在名词后加一个逗号，插入一段补充说明（同位语），可以让句子更简洁地包含背景信息，而不必另起一句。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: Placing a descriptive phrase right after a noun, set off by commas, adds background information compactly without starting a new sentence.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: Goujian, King of Yue, a ruler once known for enduring hardship to strengthen his resolve, seemed to have cast that very willpower into this blade.
extra_examples: Marie Curie, a physicist who won two Nobel Prizes, remains an inspiration to scientists today.
The museum, a century-old building near the river, houses thousands of artifacts.

sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 'The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...' 用来表达两件事情程度上同步变化的关系。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: This 'the more..., the more...' structure expresses that two things change in proportion to each other.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: The sharper a sword is, the more it depends on masterful craftsmanship to support that sharpness.
extra_examples: The older the bronze, the more carefully it must be preserved.
The more you practice translation, the more natural your sentences become.

sentence_patterns.pattern: as if it had never... (past perfect after 'as if')
sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 当 'as if' 描述的情况早于主句动作、且与事实相反时，从句用过去完成时。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: When the situation described by 'as if' happened earlier than the main verb and is contrary to fact, the clause uses the past perfect tense.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: it still lies quietly in its display case, as if it had never once been defeated by time.
extra_examples: She smiled calmly, as if nothing had happened.
The house looked untouched, as if no one had lived there for years.

vocabulary.example_zh: 这把剑由青铜铸造而成。
vocabulary.example_en: This sword was cast from bronze.
An inscription is carved into the blade.
He is known for his perseverance.

sentences.zh: 这座桥历经千年依然屹立，这本身就令人惊叹。
sentences.reference_en: That this bridge still stands after a thousand years is, in itself, astonishing.

sentences.zh: 正是这种坚持,让他最终获得了成功。
sentences.reference_en: It is precisely this persistence that eventually brought him success.

sentences.zh: 天气越冷,游客反而越多。
sentences.reference_en: The colder the weather, the more tourists there seem to be.

sentences.zh: 她平静地离开了,仿佛什么都没有发生过。
sentences.reference_en: She left calmly, as if nothing had ever happened.
